Author: dajoey
Name: LazyCrucible
Punchline: Crucible of the Unbroken familiar picks, filled in for every fight
Description: For the Beastmaster duty Crucible of the Unbroken. Fills the ten-familiar run roster at the Bentbranch Meadows entry menu and the three Battlehorn slots before every fight with the familiars that answer that fight's mechanics: elemental weakness, interrupts, dispels, cleanses and crowd control, skipping knocked-out familiars and benching badly hurt ones. Picks are announced in chat. Every automation has its own toggle and manual edits always win. Includes the beast-pick advisor for every board and a read-only recorder that writes each Crucible screen to the Dalamud log. Use /lazycrucible to open.
